about.network: Network: documents and personal data are never sent anywhere. AI models, fonts and colour profiles are built in, not downloaded. The directly installed desktop edition contacts github.com at start-up and every 6 hours to check for a new version (GitHub receives the connecting IP address).
about.storeUpdates: This copy was installed from the Microsoft Store, and the Microsoft Store keeps it up to date (the app does not check for updates itself).
